paite: Jesu Khrist kilakna, Pathian in asikhate kiang a lahkhiak ding a amah apiak, thil hong om pah mahmah dingte. Huan ama'n asikha Johan kiang ah a-angel sawl in chiamtehna in atheisak hi.
heading: Thumasa
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

paite: Johan in Pathian thu leh Jesu Khrist tungtang a athil muhte tengteng atheisakta hi.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

paite: Hiai genkholhna thute sim a, athute za a, huai a thil kigelhte zuite ahampha uhi; ahun anai tak ziak in.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

paite: Johan in Asia gam a om saptuam sagihte kiang ah, amah omlel, omsa leh hong pai ngei dingpa a kipan leh alaltutphah ma a om, Kha sagihte a kipan in hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen;
heading: Chibai Bukna Leh Phatna
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

paite: huan Jesu Khrist, theihpihpa ginom, misite lak a piang masapen leh leitung a kumpipate vaihawmpa a kipan. Eite hon it a i khelhna a kipan a asisan a hon sawppa amah kiang ngei ah;
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

paite: leh lalgam hi ding a hon bawl, Pathian leh a Pa kiang a siampute hi ding a hon bawl, amah kiang ah thupina leh vaihawmna, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ngai in, meipi toh ahong pai hi; mit teng in amah amu ding ua, amah sunte'n leng; leitung a nam tengteng in amah asuun ding uh, huai bang hi hen, Amen.
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

paite: "Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp," Toupa Pathian, omsa, omlel leh hong pai ding Bangkim hihthei in achi hi.
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

paite: Kei, Johan, na unau uleh Jesu a om haksa thuakna leh lalgam leh kuhkalna a na tanpihpa uh, Pathian thu ziak leh Jesu theihpihna ziak in tuikulh gam Patmos kichi ah ka om hi.
heading: Khrist Muhna
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

paite: Toupa ni in Kha in ka om a, ka nunglam ah aw ngaihtak in pengkul ging bang mai ka za hi.
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

paite: Aw in, "Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp ka hi, na thil muhte laibu ah gelh inla, Asia gam a saptuam sagih, Ephesa, Smarna, Pergamos, Thiatira, Sardis, Philadelphia leh Laodisia kiang ah khak in," achih ka za hi.
english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

paite: Huan kei hon houpih huai aw muh tum in ka kihei hi. Huchi a ka kiheileh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih ka mu hi.
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

paite: Huai khawnvak koihna lai ah kuahiam Mihing Tapa toh kibang, akhepek tuampha puansilh, a-awm kimvel dangka-eng gakna a kigak ka mu hi.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

paite: Alu leh asamte samul ngou leh vuk bang in angou a; amitte meikuang bang ahi.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

paite: Akhepekte sumsan nawttet meipi a halsiangsa abang a, huan a-aw tui tampi ging bang ahi.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

paite: Huan akhut taklam in aksi sagih atawi a; akam a kipan in namsau hiamtuah asuakkhia a; huan amel nisa asat san lai bang ahi.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

paite: Huchi a amah ka muhtak in, misi bang in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ama'n ka tung a akhut taklam koih in, "Lau ke'n, amasapen leh ananungpen ka hi.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

paite: Huai ahingpa ka hi; ka sita a, ngai in tangtawn in ka hing hi, sihna leh misi kho chabi ka nei hi.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

paite: Huaiziak in na thil muhsate, thil omlelte leh tunung a thil hong om dingte gelh in.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

paite: Ka khut taklam a aksi sagih na muhte leh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagihte thuguk hiai ahi: Aksi sagihte saptuam sagihte angelte ahi ua; khawnvak koihna sagihte saptuam sagihte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
